items.label: TYCOON TEX
items.why: the file the KERNAL loads, 256 bytes at $0140-$023F, over the stack. Its bytes from $01C3 to $01FF are all $02, so the KERNAL returns to $0203, which clears the screen and jumps to the stub at $0140. The stub draws the name and NOVALOAD A100000, points the load vector at the tape buffer, loads the file NOVA with the loader there and calls the game at $1800 (orientation.md, "The loader, in a paragraph")

items.label: TYCOON TEX (header)
items.why: what the file's header leaves in the tape buffer at $0333: its addresses and name, then Novaload's turbo loader from $0348 to $03F1, which reads a file as blocks of 256 bytes with a checksum after each and times every wave with TED's timer 2
